prompt: Objective: speed up a factory's changeovers between products. What you've learned: changeovers take 4 hours on average. Latest finding: half the time is spent waiting for tools and parts. What is the best next step?

options.text: Time each changeover step again to confirm the 4 hours
Compare changeover times with other factories
options.feedback: Secondary: half the time is waiting, a clear lever.

options.text: Size the time saved by staging tools in advance
options.feedback: Right. Waiting is half the time, so pre-staging is the lever to size.

options.text: Price new machines with faster changeovers
options.feedback: That jumps to an expensive fix before the cheap one.

explanation: Half the changeover time is waiting for tools and parts. Size what staging them in advance would save.
